children: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals will effect a 1-for-7 reverse stock split effective December 2, 2026, before trading on Nasdaq. Outstanding shares will fall from approximately 4,484,622 to approximately 560,578; the company says the split is intended to address Nasdaq’s minimum bid price requirement.
The ratio mechanically reduces share count; it does not itself change holders’ percentage ownership, except for fractional-share rounding.
The release provides no prior-period comparison; the share-count reduction is mechanical, not an increase in company value.
Aims to meet Nasdaq minimum bid requirement
The split is intended to address a listing-compliance issue; continued compliance is not assured by the announcement.
This is a listing-compliance action, not a change to the company’s operating business. The next catalyst is whether the post-split share price satisfies Nasdaq’s minimum bid price requirement.
